cover.title: Button
cover.subtitle: Buttons trigger actions and let users make choices with a single tap or click — the primary driver of interaction in any interface.

parts.name: Container
parts.description: The outer frame defining size, background, border, and radius. Changes per Type & Size.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: Required action text. Always a verb phrase describing the outcome. Controlled via buttonText property.

parts.name: Left Icon
parts.description: Optional icon left of the label to reinforce action meaning. Shown when iconLeft = true.

parts.name: Right Icon
parts.description: Optional icon right of the label, typically for direction or submenu. Shown when iconRight = true.

values.description: Filled high-emphasis. Use for the single most important action on a screen.
Tinted medium-emphasis. Use when a Primary is already present and a supporting action is needed.
Outlined low-emphasis. Use for less critical actions in cards, list rows, or alongside Primary.
No background, no border. Use for low-priority inline actions embedded in content or toolbars. Available in SM & MD only.
Resting state. No interaction has occurred.
Cursor is positioned over the button on desktop. Background darkens to indicate interactivity.
Action is unavailable. Button is non-interactive and visually muted at 50% opacity. Always pair with helper text explaining why.

items.name: iconLeft
items.purpose: Adds an icon to the left of the label to visually reinforce the action.
items.when: Use when the icon adds meaning — e.g. a download arrow before 'Export', a search icon before 'Find'.

items.name: iconRight
items.purpose: Adds an icon to the right of the label, typically to indicate direction or a submenu.
items.when: Use for navigation actions ('Next →'), external links, or dropdown triggers.

items.name: buttonText
items.purpose: The visible action label shown inside the button.
items.when: Always set. Use a verb phrase that describes the outcome, not the interaction.

do.title: Gunakan satu Primary per screen section
do.body: Reserve Primary untuk satu aksi terpenting. Dua Primary berdampingan menghilangkan hierarki dan membuat user ragu harus klik yang mana.

visual.caption: Hierarki jelas — satu aksi dominan, satu pendukung

dont.title: Jangan taruh dua Primary button berdampingan
dont.body: Dua CTA dengan emphasis sama menciptakan decision paralysis — user tidak tahu mana yang 'benar'.

do.title: Tulis label yang mendeskripsikan outcome
do.body: 'Send invoice', 'Delete account', 'Export data' — user tahu persis apa yang terjadi sebelum klik.

visual.caption: Label outcome-oriented — aksi jelas tanpa baca konteks

dont.title: Jangan pakai label vague seperti 'Submit' atau 'OK'
dont.body: Label generik memaksa user membaca konteks di sekitarnya, meningkatkan cognitive load dan potensi error.

do.title: Tampilkan Disabled dengan helper text
do.body: Jelaskan mengapa aksi belum tersedia. User harus tahu apa yang perlu dilakukan agar button aktif kembali.

visual.caption: Disabled + helper text: 'Add at least one item to your cart'

dont.title: Jangan tampilkan Disabled tanpa konteks
dont.body: Disabled button tanpa penjelasan membuat user bingung — mereka tidak tahu apa yang memblokir aksi mereka.

visual.caption: Disabled sendiri — user tidak tahu penyebabnya

do.title: Gunakan icon saat benar-benar menambah makna
do.body: Icon yang relevan mempercepat pengenalan aksi. iconLeft ideal untuk aksi dengan representasi visual universal (download, search, add).

dont.title: Jangan aktifkan iconLeft dan iconRight bersamaan
dont.body: Dua icon mengapit label menciptakan visual noise dan mengurangi prominence label itu sendiri.

visual.caption: Dua icon — label tenggelam, fokus terpecah

cards.description: Satu aksi terpenting di layar. Gunakan hanya sekali per section atau view.
Aksi pendukung saat Primary sudah ada di dekatnya.
Aksi prioritas rendah di card, list row, atau berdampingan dengan grup Primary.
Aksi minimal-chrome yang embedded dalam konten, toolbar, atau inline flow. (SM & MD only)

notes: Minimum touch target 44×44pt — jangan gunakan Size=SM untuk primary CTA standalone di mobile.
Label button harus mendeskripsikan outcome aksi: 'Save changes', bukan 'Click here' atau 'Submit'.
Disabled button harus tetap bisa difokus — gunakan aria-disabled='true' bukan atribut disabled agar screen reader tetap mengumumkan tombol.
Saat iconLeft/iconRight aktif, set icon ke aria-hidden='true' — label sudah mendeskripsikan aksi, icon tidak perlu dibaca ulang.
